Aatrox killed the celestial Aspect of War inhabiting Atreus; Atreus survived and later opposed Aatrox.
Akali trained under Shen within the Kinkou before leaving the order.
Akali and Kennen are tied through the Kinkou Order.
Ashe and Sejuani are rival Freljordian war leaders with conflicting visions for the region.
Ashe and Tryndamere are oathbound spouses and political allies.
Xerath betrayed Azir at the moment of Ascension, causing Shurima's fall.
Sivir's bloodline is tied to Azir and enables his return.
Nasus and Renekton are brothers who became Ascended.
Nasus opposed Xerath after the fall of Shurima and Renekton's imprisonment.
Renekton and Xerath were trapped together, with Xerath poisoning Renekton's mind against Nasus.
Caitlyn and Vi operate as partners in Piltover law enforcement.
Jinx and Vi are sisters whose relationship is central to Piltover and Zaun's modern conflict.
Darius and Draven are brothers from Noxus.
Garen and Lux are siblings of House Crownguard.
Katarina and Cassiopeia are sisters of the Du Couteau family.
Kayle and Morgana are twin sisters, daughters of a Targonian Aspect host.
Yasuo and Yone are brothers; Yasuo killed Yone in their duel, and Yone later returned.
Xayah and Rakan are romantic partners and rebel allies.
Lucian and Senna are married Sentinels of Light.
Thresh imprisoned Senna's soul in his lantern before Lucian freed her.
Lucian hunted Thresh after Senna was taken into the lantern.
Kalista is Viego's niece and served Camavor before the Ruination.
Swain and Darius are leading figures in Noxus's post-coup government.
Irelia fought Swain during the Noxian invasion of Ionia and severed his arm.
Riven's broken runic blade was involved in Elder Souma's death, the crime for which Yasuo was blamed.
Zed and Shen were once close students before Zed's break from the Kinkou made them rivals.
Zed is Kayn's master in the Order of Shadow.
Shen and Kennen serve the Kinkou Order.
Shen helped hunt and capture Jhin before the virtuoso returned.
Zed was involved with Shen in hunting Jhin.
Aatrox and Varus are Darkin linked to the ancient wars of the fallen Ascended.
Aatrox and Naafiri are Darkin whose existence stems from the fallen Ascended.
Kayn is Zed's most notable protégé.
Kayn wields the Darkin scythe Rhaast and struggles against its possession.
Kai'Sa is widely established as Kassadin's lost daughter within current Void lore.
Bel'Veth directly confronts Kai'Sa and attempts to use her against the Watchers.
Leona and Diana share a personal history before becoming embodiments of opposing Targonian faiths.
Ornn and Volibear are Freljordian demigod siblings with a hostile history.
Ornn and Anivia belong to the same family of Freljordian demigods.
Volibear and Anivia are ancient Freljordian demigod siblings.
Lux secretly helped imprisoned Sylas before his escape ignited the mage rebellion.
Shyvana saved Jarvan and later served Demacia under his protection.
Shen trained Akali as a Kinkou disciple.
Miss Fortune destroyed Gangplank's ship and seized influence in Bilgewater after years of seeking revenge.
Graves and Twisted Fate are long-time partners in crime despite periods of betrayal.
Illaoi and Gangplank share a past romantic relationship.
Hecarim betrayed Kalista during the events leading to the Ruination.
Hecarim served Viego's military campaign and became one of the Ruination's central figures.
Thresh manipulated Viego's return before eventually pursuing his own power.
Viego hunted the fragment of Isolde within Senna during the Ruination.
Gwen opposed Viego and carries a connection to Isolde through her creation.
Morgana and Kayle are twin sisters whose conflict shaped early Demacia.
Diana and Aphelios are central figures in the Lunari faith.
Aphelios is guided by his twin sister Alune from the spirit realm.
Ryze once travelled with Kegan Rodhe, who became Brand after taking a World Rune.
Vladimir is Viego's uncle from the royal family of Camavor.
LeBlanc's Black Rose has long worked to prevent Mordekaiser's return.
Singed is tied to the experiments that transformed Warwick, though current Arcane reconciliation should be reviewed.
Viktor and Jayce share a defining scientific and ideological relationship; current details are being reconciled with Arcane-era canon.
Ambessa is Mel Medarda's mother; their relationship drives Medarda family politics.
Jinx and Ekko share a personal Zaunite past; current details depend on Arcane reconciliation.
Arcane strongly ties Warwick to Vi's family history; exact cross-media reconciliation remains unsettled.
Garen is among the Demacian champions directly opposed to Sylas's rebellion.
Sylas's rebellion directly threatens Jarvan IV and Demacia's ruling order.
Yasuo taught Taliyah to better control her stone magic during her travels.
Master Yi trained Wukong in Wuju.
Lee Sin and Udyr share an Ionian connection and documented mutual history.
Rengar and Kha'Zix are defining rivals, each hunting the other.
Kassadin's crusade against the Void places him against Malzahar, its prophet.
Xerath betrayed Azir and caused the empire's collapse.
Cassiopeia hired Sivir for a Shuriman expedition and betrayed her in the tomb.
Thresh became Lucian's defining enemy after capturing Senna.
Thresh held Senna's soul in his lantern.
Udyr is closely tied to Sejuani and the Winter's Claw.
Ashe's Avarosan legacy conflicts with Lissandra's hidden rule and history.
Lissandra and Volibear are tied to ancient Freljordian conflict.
Evelynn murdered Vayne's parents, driving Vayne's lifelong hunt for monsters.
Rell was shaped by Black Rose experimentation and seeks revenge against the organization led by LeBlanc.
Briar was created as a Black Rose weapon, linking her to LeBlanc's organization.
Annie's bear Tibbers is tied to the demon Tybaulk.
Nilah is bound to Ashlesh, a powerful demon of joy.
Zoe interacts with Aurelion Sol as a celestial Aspect figure.
Pantheon and Aurelion Sol are both entangled with Targon's celestial power, but not necessarily through a direct personal relationship.
